item.title: All-in-one mini PC aims to replace your dock, screen, and phone charger
item.description: The ViewDock Gen2 is a mini PC that combines Ryzen-powered performance with a built-in display, wireless charging, and a full I/O in a compact vertical design.

item.title: BMW turns April Fool's joke into Nürburgring race car
item.description: It was one of those April Fool’s jokes that PR departments love to make.

item.title: Tiny EDC tool puts a 67-layer Damascus steel knife and bottle opener on your keychain
item.description: EDC hardware brand Orioner says this new folding knife is the smallest piece of kit it's ever made: it's about half the length of your pinky. But there's more to it than its diminutive proportions.

item.title: New supercool alloy could take the heat off helium-3
item.description: The heated race to achieve the extreme cold that quantum technologies demand may have a frontrunner. Chinese scientists have developed an alloy that almost reaches absolute zero, the coldest possible temperature, without using the scarce isotope, helium-3.

item.title: 60-sec cube camper rises &amp; slides into much more than meets the eye
item.description: South African camping trailer specialist Invader is developing the all-new Viator as a roomier, more luxurious alternative to its smaller fold-out trailers. Like its other models, the Viator packs low and rugged for on/off-road travel and expands at camp. But it features a longer body and…

item.title: Three-wheeled scooter comes equipped with an airbag
item.description: Safety on a motorcycle is a double-edged sword. On one hand, safety is paramount when you’re riding on two wheels. But on the other hand, how far are you willing to go to safeguard yourself without interfering with the riding experience?

item.title: Off-grid tiny house is well-suited to full-time nomadic lifestyle
item.description: This compact tiny house doubles down on one of the major benefits of small living: freedom. The home runs off-grid and combines an easy-to-tow configuration with an open layout that's arranged on one floor.

item.title: Dual RGB-laser projector promises lights-on viewing up to 300 inches
item.description: Consumer tech giant Hisense unveiled a high-end tri-laser projector at CES 2026 that put out 6,000 lumens and could throw visuals at 300 inches. It's a beast, and we now have more details and, most importantly, pricing.

item.title: This 80s-style boombox with cassette decks and Bluetooth is ready to rock your block party
item.description: Bumpboxx has been in the party speaker business for over a decade, with a number of models styled like 'ghetto blasters' that you can carry on your shoulder all old-school like. Its latest product is a proper throwback boombox, complete with cassette decks and a CD player – along with thoughtful…

item.title: Ultraportable adapter unlocks clipless bike pedals into casual platforms
item.description: Although so-called "clipless" pedals are great for serious cycling, they can be pretty inconvenient for simple trips to the store and such. Redshift Sports' Mousetrap Pedal Adapters are made to help, by instantly adding platforms to clipless pedals.

item.title: Stealthy 4x4 camper wagon stays course as one of cheapest out there
item.description: An "extreme" hard-sided 4x4 camper rig for under £30,000? That's exactly what Dacia launched a few years ago in adding an overnight "Sleep Pack" to its venerable Duster and Jogger utility vehicles. Now the Romanian badge expands its in-vehicle camping series out to new vehicles and new components.…

item.title: Mesmerizing hand-crafted dragon 'soars' with soothing movement
item.description: A wooden dragon sculpture that gently flaps its wings has become a crowd-funding hit, but after seeing the traditional handcrafted work that's been put into every single model, making each one unique, the value of such a piece becomes strikingly clear.

item.title: Modular Android tablet promises to last a decade with swappable batteries and storage
item.description: We've seen a small number of modular phones with replaceable parts over the last few years, and Lenovo's been following Framework's lead in developing a modular laptop. What if you're in the market for something in between?

item.title: The STRiX electric moto will have enduro purists drooling
item.description: An electric enduro motorcycle is nothing new. They’ve been popping up in big numbers, of late. From big-name manufacturers like Stark to niche startups and even some Chinese brands, the electric off-road dirt bike space is buzzing with capable options. So what’s special about this one?

item.description: The latest Global Energy Crisis (Version 7.3) made the opening of the 2026 Bangkok International Motor Show (BIMS) much more important than it might have been just a few weeks ago.
